story.title: p2p: add option to limit inbound connections per network

events.body: Adds a -maxinboundpernet option so node operators can cap how many inbound peers come from a single network type (IPv4, IPv6, Tor, I2P). Motivation: reduce the chance that one network fills all inbound slots. Feedback welcome on the default.

cannedOutput.headline: Bitcoin Core proposal would limit inbound connections per network
cannedOutput.whatHappened: A pull request in bitcoin proposes a new option, -maxinboundpernet, for people who run Bitcoin nodes. It is open for review and has not been accepted.
cannedOutput.previously: A node has a fixed number of slots for other computers that connect to it. Nothing stops one type of network from filling all of them.
cannedOutput.whatChanged: Nothing has changed in the code yet. The proposal would let operators cap how many incoming connections come from one network type, such as Tor or IPv4.
cannedOutput.whyItMatters: If one network can fill every slot, a node is easier to isolate from honest peers. This option would give node operators another way to protect their nodes.
cannedOutput.nextConfirmed: The author is asking for feedback on the default setting.
cannedOutput.nextSpeculative: Reviewers might ask for changes before deciding whether to accept it.

glossary.definition: A computer that runs Bitcoin software and shares transactions and blocks with others.
A connection that another computer starts to your node.
A network that hides where internet traffic comes from.
A proposed code change that others review before deciding whether to accept it.

cannedOutput.analogy: It is like a restaurant deciding that no single tour group can take every table, so other guests can still get a seat.
cannedOutput.intermediate: Pull request #33790 proposes a -maxinboundpernet option that caps inbound peers per network type: IPv4, IPv6, Tor and I2P.
cannedOutput.technical: The proposed -maxinboundpernet option bounds inbound peer slots per network class to reduce the risk that one network type exhausts inbound capacity. The default value is still under discussion.
